commits.message:
A declared width and a noWrap column too wide for the table are cut evenly together, as Rich's last-resort ratio_reduce cuts them (rich-unfiled-791c.py6q)

layoutTable paid every reservation before any minimum, so a noWrap column
beside a declared width gave up all its cells alone. A declared width is now
a minimum that weighs nothing, and the one minimum pass cuts the wrapping
columns first and then every column evenly. Pinned against Rich 15 in
table-squeeze.golden.txt.

A Viewport whose content is handed no column keeps its offset, and a ListView keeps its wheel position (rich-widgets-hmk1.0ix) (#473)

* A Viewport whose content is handed no column keeps its offset, and a ListView keeps its wheel position (rich-widgets-hmk1.0ix)

Law pass over presence and render-time state. A Viewport drawn no wider
than its gutter held its content and clamped its offset against the
nothing that came back, resetting it to 0; it now keeps the length the
last drawing render found. A ListView whose items were held followed the
empty range they named, which read as a selection move and undid the
wheel. Also reattaches withBoundedWidth's doc comment, which measuring
had been inserted below.

* A Viewport render that holds its content commits nothing: offset, followed range and queued moves wait for a render that draws (rich-widgets-hmk1.0ix)

Review of #473: a held render kept the last length but took its rows from
the empty render, so under a ceiling or no height the follow re-ensure moved
the offset, canScrollBy reported moves past the last full view, queued moves
resolved while nothing was shown, and the gutter drew zero rows.
